recentItems.title: Unlock China's Economy: CIFTIS, CIIE, CICPE... Keywords are the key
recentItems.description:
From Sept. 9 to 13, the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (#CIFTIS) will be held at Shougang Park in Beijing.
CIFTIS, CIIE, CICPE... Having trouble telling them apart?
Iramsy, a Latin American journalist who has lived and worked in China for many years, is here to help. In just three minutes, she'll show you how to tell these major expos apart once and for all.

recentItems.description: Participants at the ongoing AI Summit 2026 Budapest hailed China as a top global AI player, citing its rapid industrial development, complete industry system and pioneering open-source contributions. #AI #Budapest #AISummit #China

recentItems.title: CIFTIS a two-way bridge for China-ASEAN cooperation: Malaysian think tank leader
recentItems.description: "It is key to combine Malaysia's local application scenarios with Chinese technologies to create greater added value in Malaysia and across the ASEAN region," said Malaysian think tank leader Tan Kar Hing ahead of the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS), set to be held from Sept. 9 to 13 in Beijing. #China #ASEAN #CIFTIS

recentItems.title: Exploring Yakou: How a coffee village nurtures local prosperity | Sunny's Spotlight
recentItems.description: More than 150 coffee shops and stalls sit among the rice fields of Yakou Village in south China's Guangdong Province. Through the eyes of Mexican media influencer Diego Ruzzarin, discover how the village is creating opportunities, attracting talent back home and turning growth into prosperity.
